detail.summary: Continued investigation into the intersection of predictive processing and reward systems within music cognition. While current notebooks establish a link between surprise minimization and musical experience, deeper integration of dopamine-mediated reward mechanisms is required to fully model the valence of musical tension and resolution. I am expanding the research scope to include literature on predictive coding and reward neurobiology.
